title: Next Step Cards
user: A person with executive-function fatigue who needs to resume a real task after interruption without reopening an overwhelming project plan or relying on a chat assistant.
smallest_useful_product: An offline PWA with one active card: task name, next 2-minute action, required link/file, why it matters, and a completion/park decision. It can schedule a gentle local reminder and show a re-entry history.
constraints: No dark patterns, streaks or guilt notifications; all data local/exportable; reminders respect OS quiet hours and reduced-motion preferences; no clinical claims.
